I have resolved the proxy authentication bug in [`prepend_scheme_if_needed`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mevoxddx/requests/utils.py#L960-L987).

### Cause
In [requests/utils.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mevoxddx/requests/utils.py), [`prepend_scheme_if_needed`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mevoxddx/requests/utils.py#L960-L987) uses `urllib3.util.parse_url(url)` and reconstructs the URL using `parsed.netloc`. Because `urllib3.util.url.Url.netloc` only includes `host` and `port` (omitting `auth`), any proxy authentication credentials in the proxy URL were stripped before [`HTTPAdapter.proxy_manager_for`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mevoxddx/requests/adapters.py#L167-L202) and [`HTTPAdapter.proxy_headers`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mevoxddx/requests/adapters.py#L373-L393) extracted the credentials.

### Fix
Updated [`prepend_scheme_if_needed`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-mevoxddx/requests/utils.py#L960-L987) to prepend `auth` to `netloc` (`'@'.join([auth, netloc])`) when `auth` is present.
